annotations.bosses: The Goblin King (goblin-kings-hall area_4), the dungeon's boss.
annotations.identity: The Goblin King's own halls, below Grutt's: older, carved stone, bones and stolen finery. A solo dungeon: a straight descent with a side vault.
annotations.poi: Guard posts; Barracks; Worg Kennels; Court of Bones; Goblin King's Throne; The Hoard.
annotations.structure: kings-stair, then royal-warrens and court-of-bones, then the King's hall; the treasure vault off the warrens is optional.

description: A solo dungeon below the Gnawdeep: the Goblin King and his court.

name: Hall of the Goblin King

goblin-hexer.description: A wizened goblin with a bag of bones and grudges.
goblin-hexer.name: Goblin Hexer

powers.description: A curse that saps the target's strength.
powers.name: Hex of Weakness

powers.description: A slow rot that eats at the target.
powers.name: Withering Curse

annotations.balance: A g1 boss, tuned by hand: twice a g1 solo's HP (1500). Three phases: Tantrum below 60%, an enrage (Greedy Rage) below 25%.
annotations.intent: Boss of the Hall of the Goblin King, and L3's finale. Fights in his throne hall; his royal guard and court shamans may join through Royal Decree's buff.

goblin-king.description: Fat, gilded and furious, the King of the Gnawdeep goblins sits on a throne of stolen things.
goblin-king.name: The Goblin King

powers.description: Brings his heavy scepter down on the target's head.
powers.name: Scepter Smash

powers.description: A backhand swipe with a gold-ringed fist.
powers.name: Kingly Swipe

powers.description: Bellows an order; his court fights harder for him.
powers.name: Royal Decree

powers.description: Stamps and flails at everything around him.
powers.name: Tantrum

powers.description: Clutching his hoard, he flies into a greedy rage.
powers.name: Mine, All Mine

goblin-mender.description: Mutters war-chants and slaps poultices on its packmates.
goblin-mender.name: Goblin Mender

powers.description: Slaps a poultice on the most wounded goblin nearby.
powers.name: Mend Wounds

powers.description: A rousing chant that sharpens the whole pack's spite.
powers.name: War Chant

annotations.intent: The Hall of the Goblin King's elite: g1 (a solo-dungeon elite), in pairs at the royal warrens and the King's hall door. Tough: long fights that cost the same HP as a g1 pair.

goblin-royal-guard.description: One of the King's picked guards: bigger than most goblins, better armored, and very loyal.
goblin-royal-guard.name: Goblin Royal Guard

powers.description: A wide sweep of its halberd.
powers.name: Halberd Sweep

powers.description: Slams its shield into the target's face.
powers.name: Shield Bash

powers.description: Braces behind its shield, determined to hold.
powers.name: For the King

worg.description: A cunning, malicious wolf; goblins and orcs ride them to war.
worg.name: Worg

powers.description: A ripping bite that leaves the target bleeding.
powers.name: Savage Bite

powers.description: A menacing snarl that shakes the target's nerve.
powers.name: Snarl
